claim: spec < 拉丁 specere「看」；spectare 为其反复形

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: From Latin inspectum, past participle of inspicio, inspicere 'to look into', from in + specio, specere 'to look at', equivalent to spect.

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: From Latin expectāre, infinitive form of exspectō 'look out for, await, expect', from out + spectō 'look at', of speciō 'see'.

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from perspectus, the past participle of perspicere 'to inspect, look through', itself from per- 'through' + specere 'to look at'

note: 三条独立条目均直接给出 specere/speciō；inspect 与 perspective 明写 specere 原形。
